tools.name: book_demo
tools.description: Get the URL to book a free personalized demo of Holded with a product specialist. Useful for businesses that want a guided tour before signing up.

tools.name: get_holded_mcp_server
tools.description: Get connection details for the official Holded MCP server, which lets AI agents act on a Holded account with the user’s authorization: list invoices, look up contacts, check treasury and inventory, create payments.

tools.name: get_pricing_plans
tools.description: Get the current Holded pricing plans: name, monthly price in EUR (billed annually), current promotional price and included users. Includes the URL of the full pricing page with the feature comparison.

tools.name: search_holded_website
tools.description: Search holded.com content (blog posts, guides, product and feature pages, glossary) about Holded, the cloud ERP and business management software for SMEs and freelancers in Spain. Returns matching pages with title, description and URL.

query.description: Search terms, ideally in the language of the page (e.g. "electronic invoicing", "verifactu", "accounting").

tools.name: start_free_trial
tools.description: Get the direct signup URL to start a free 14-day Holded trial (no credit card required). Optionally pre-selects a plan: plus, basic, standard, advanced or premium.

plan.description: Optional plan to pre-select on the signup form.
